teaser: Three missed calls sit on your phone by the time you finish organizing someone else's crisis, and you call back anyway. Life path 9 asks you to let go for the larger good; you are an ESTJ, wired to hold the structure that letting go threatens. That is the shape of this crossing: compassion large enough to take in strangers, handled by a will that wants to manage the outcome rather than simply release it. The 9 wants the gesture to be open-handed; the ESTJ in you wants it scheduled, staffed, and followed up on.
